scope: Source references and reachability notes for 20 unobserved renderer functions. This lexical supplement does not certify absence of indirect calls, runtime coverage, or independent visual acceptance. No synthetic call contributes to observed counts. The native-routes supplement records subsequent host progress for these original gaps.

routes.scope: Same translation unit for the generic C identifier lane. Others cover firmware sources.
routes.coverage: Native exception callback. Fault and boot notices have real display captures.
routes.supplementalEvidence: The complete fault function draws its diagnostics, polls its timer and requests a host reset. Its framebuffer matches the archived diagnostic.

routes.coverage: Both source-backed mode-entry display prefixes have captures.
routes.supplementalEvidence: The complete function executes both direct and USB-request paths, checks detach/delays, clears pending in RAM and reaches the modeled bootloader endpoint.

routes.scope: Same translation unit for the generic C identifier lane. Others cover firmware sources.
routes.coverage: Safe mode and software retry have retained-framebuffer captures. The native wait and reboot are hardware-owned.
routes.supplementalEvidence: The full safe_main function handles held PLAY across its time guard and a modeled USB bootloader request. Both core cases, prompted retry and the resulting endpoints are checked.

routes.scope: Same translation unit for the generic C identifier lane. Others cover firmware sources.
routes.coverage: Board startup. Both returning-from-crash display variants have captures.
routes.supplementalEvidence: The native RAM-only prefix covers both post-crash notices. A second fixture executes the complete normal fm1_main with accepted emulated flash through actual UI frames and the updater request. See native-routes/normal-loop/normal-loop.json.

routes.scope: Same translation unit for the generic C identifier lane. Others cover firmware sources.
routes.coverage: Assembly enters the real board startup entry.
routes.supplementalEvidence: Complete fm1_cstart over private linker regions enters the original fm1_main RAM-only prefix and safe_main on simulated failed starts. Default boot and both post-crash notices match the archived frames. Four consecutive failures exit to the modeled updater before LCD initialization.
